title: Correctness: GEN_IV iv_set=true despite copy_to_user failure
description:
Location: crypto2dev_fd.c ioctl_gen_iv().

Trigger: ioctl(CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_GEN_IV) — gen_iv() generates IV, set_iv() installs it in the provider context (state->iv_set = true, line 764), then copy_to_user() fails (bad userspace pointer) at line 768 → returns -EFAULT.

Bad outcome: The session has iv_set=true and the IV is installed in the provider crypto context, but the caller received -EFAULT and does not have the IV value. The caller cannot know what IV was programmed. If the caller retries GEN_IV, a NEW IV is generated and installed (the previous one is lost). If the caller proceeds to encrypt (seeing iv_set=true will succeed), the IV used for encryption was never returned to userspace, making decryption impossible.

Fix: only set iv_set=true after copy_to_user succeeds, or clear the IV on copy_to_user failure.
